summary: SoundFont-based software synthesizer with a CLI shell and library API. It accepts MIDI events and can play MIDI files; the available sounds depend on a separately supplied SoundFont.
use_when: Render or play MIDI with a suitable SoundFont
avoid_when: Need a programmable synthesis score: Csound
Need audio analysis rather than synthesis: librosa
